tools.guest_kernel: Linux (none) 6.1.0-54-amd64 #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Debian 6.1.190-1 (2026-10-16) x86_64 GNU/Linux

environment.zfs: available: OpenZFS 2.1.11-1+deb12u1 built by DKMS for 6.1.0-54-amd64; real pool in the guest, file-backed vdev (whole-disk vdev needs udev partition nodes that the minimal guest does not run)

method.cold: guest runs `sync; echo 3 > /proc/sys/vm/drop_caches` immediately before the run
method.warm: the next run on the same files, with no cache drop
method.results_disk: raw ext4 virtio-blk, extracted with debugfs; no loop mount
method.root: read-only ext4 image built in the vm court
method.vms: QEMU -smp 4 -m 1536M; the host court is limited to 4 CPUs and 3 GiB
method.weftfs: Rust and Go WeftFS are mounted over FUSE inside the guest; store and mount live on the ext4 data disk
method.zero_buffers: fio write buffers default to zeros; WeftFS chunk dedup can therefore reduce stored bytes. This receipt measures latency/IOPS, not storage amplification.
method.not_claimed: No physical power loss, no host page-cache drop, no ZFS run, and no dedicated graph database.
